data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'changez', meaning to change or transform. This name is often given to a child who is expected to bring about positive change in the world or in people's lives. It is also associated with the idea of transformation, growth, and renewal. The name Changeez carries the meaning “Changer, Transformer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Changeez usually hope their child will grow to embody changer, transformer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
